headline: Thailand Q3 GDP Growth Accelerates to 2.9% Year-on-Year
summary: Thailand's economy expanded by 2.9% year-on-year in the third quarter, ranking fifth among six major Southeast Asian economies.
why: GDP growth figures are key indicators for assessing economic momentum and monetary policy expectations in Southeast Asia.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Accelerating quarterly GDP growth reflects stronger domestic and regional economic activity.
